# Membrane Stream plugin v0.4.2 - Table of Contents

> Plugin for dumping and restoring a Membrane Stream to and from a binary format

## Pages

- [Membrane Stream Plugin](https://membrane-stream-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-stream-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.Stream.Deserializer](https://membrane-stream-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Stream.Deserializer.md): Element restoring recorded data in Membrane.Stream format, as captured by `Membrane.Stream.Serializer`
- [Membrane.Stream.Format.Version](https://membrane-stream-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Stream.Format.Version.md): Module describing version used by the format

- [Membrane.Stream.Serializer](https://membrane-stream-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Stream.Serializer.md): Element recording a stream of Membrane actions into binary format, suitable for saving to the file.
